name: Hot Bait
source:
It's the first day at school and everyone knows that if you are alone at the end of the day, you will be alone forever. In this narrative adventure you play a plucky individual navigating the treacherous waters of high school. Find your one true love by the end of the day or die alone!

[From [url=http://globalgamejam.org/2017/games/hot-bait]Global Game Jam[/url]]

Created for Global Game Jam 2017.
translation:
开学第一天，所有人都知道，如果放学时你还是孤身一人，那就会永远孤独。在这场叙事冒险中，你将扮演一个勇敢的人，在险恶的高中生活中前行。放学前找到唯一真爱，否则孤独终老！

（来源：[url=http://globalgamejam.org/2017/games/hot-bait]Global Game Jam[/url]）
